text:
eva: Quick different proposal to cut down long-tail postmortem items. Idea: lane-based follow-ups + micro-handoffs. Want a lightweight pilot for 4 weeks. Thoughts?

mike: explain lanes?

eva: three lanes: quick-fix (<=48h), sprint-lane (<=21d), program-lane (>21d). Each lane has clear owner, acceptance criteria, and takeover policy. Minimizes auto-takeovers for multi-week work.

eva: Proposed minimal timeline (example):
```
T+0: incident posted, IC assigned, impact tags (latency/errors/data-loss), lane chosen (quick/sprint/program)
T+6h: initial triage note + temporary mitigation in-thread
T+48h: if unresolved -> quick-fix must have owner+ETA or escalate to sprint-lane
T+7d: sprint-lane owners set verification metric and ETA; weekly 1-line updates in-thread
T+21d: sprint-lane closure gate: verify metric or assign program sponsor
T+45d: program-lane checkpoint & quarterly sponsor review
T+90d: long-term closure or plan recorded
```

eva: Takeover policy: quick-fix auto-escalates to oncall shadow after 48h without an ETA. Sprint-lane requires explicit owner acceptance; if owner silent at T+7d, followup-bot reassigns to escrow pool (rotating team lead) and pings product. Program-lane never auto-takes; requires sponsor.

rachael: liking the lane names. Can we add a "verification example" snippet so owners know what qualifies (smoke test, metric delta, e2e)?

priya: followup-bot can create tracker cards with lane, ETA, and a required verification field. I'll wire the webhook to refuse cards missing verification for sprint-lane and quick-fix. For program-lane, verification optional but sponsor required.

followup-bot: webhook_created -> "tracker_card for thread 2612345678 (lane=undefined)".

mike: IC rotation tweak: 2-week IC windows but maintain a 3-day overlap where outgoing IC posts a 3-line handoff: (1) current mitigations, (2) top-2 open actions, (3) inbox for followups. Shadow expected to confirm. Reduces surprises.

rachael: for recurrence detection, propose a "3-in-60" rule: if a service has 3 incidents with the same symptom tag in 60d, auto-tag threads with pattern-review. Keep review to 30m, output = hypothesis + one deployable mitigation.

eva: good. we'll measure pilot success by median time-to-close and percent of items moved to program-lane. Pilot owners: priya (automation), mike (IC handoff doc + pilot IC), rachael (playbook text + verification examples), eva (pilot lead). Please ack below so followup-bot can assign cards.

priya: ack 44d wiring tracker + verification enforcement.

mike: ack 44d will run IC handoff pilot next rotation.

rachael: ack. will draft verification examples and short checklist.

eva: thanks. followup-bot: please create a pilot tracker card when we tag the next P1 and set reminders at T+48 and T+7d.

followup-bot: action_created -> "pilot_tracker_card_2612345678", reminders set T+48,T+7d,T+21d.

eva: final note: owners must post a 1-line daily status during active sprint-lane. Keeps everyone in the loop without long meetings. If missed >48h, followup-bot nudges owner and escalates to escrow after another 24h.

mike: sounds manageable. thanks all. I'll run the handoff dry-run and post results here.

priya: will post integration notes and card link once automation is live.

followup-bot: reminder_scheduled -> "T+48 quick-fix check" for thread 2612345678.
